data.name: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
data.detailed_description:
You were sentenced to three years in prison for smuggling black market goods. You were very, very guilty. It would have been a much longer sentence if they knew full extent of your operation.

You've completed your sentence and have been exiled to a remote space station in order to manage their general store. You're on probation and the authorities will be watching you closely.

You'll start from nothing and will need to manage your shop well in order to turn a profit and finally buy a ship to escape a life of retail servitude. Will you be able to turn a profit doing honest business, or will you return to your old ways in order to boost your earnings?

Stock your shop, make deals with suppliers and buyers, and move some serious inventory while trying to avoid going back to prison in this science fiction shop simulator. Make buy and sell decisions that will affect your profits, losses, and reputation during the process of working through your parole in this text-based trading game.

NOTE: The CRT effect can be turned off if you prefer to play with a "clean" interface.

data.short_description: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?
